observation: ironKrakenWreckVisuals replaces a dead hulk whose hulkVisual points at the kraken. It is the successor of that fight, not a placed prop. Round 7 never entered flight, so no kraken died and no wreck was spawned. No wreck mesh was in the scene.
decision: No builder edit. The wreck route was not reached.
next: Orchestrator can judge the wreck after a kraken kill in a live round. This pass does not have that frame.
